description: Backlog ejecutable para convertir Creapolis en un independent product studio de clase mundial, basado en review.md.

workflow: Select the first pending feature whose dependencies are done
Confirm no other feature is in_progress
Set the selected feature to in_progress
Implement only the declared scope and acceptance criteria
Set completed_at and change status to done
